## Vanguard Enforcer (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
Female human brawler (titan) 9  
LN Medium humanoid (human)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** Perception +12  

**Defense**

 **AC** 25, touch 12, flat-footed 23 (+13 armor, +1 deflection, +1 Dex)  
**hp** 126 (9d10+36)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +8, **Will** +6  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft. (30 ft. unarmored)  
**Melee** +1 adamantine greatsword +16/+11 (2d6+8) or unarmed strike +14/+9 (1d10+5) or unarmed strike flurry of blows +12/+12/+7/+7 (1d10+5)  
**Ranged** +1 military pistol +12/+7 (1d8+3/x4) or semi-automatic +1 military pistol +10/+10/+5 (1d8+3/x4)  
**Special Attacks** brawler’s flurry, brawler’s strike (cold iron, magic, silver), gun training (military pistol), havoc charge (+3 attack; –3 AC; +2d6 damage), hail of bullets (5/day)  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** Vanguard Enforcers soften opponents up with semi-automatic gunfire before entering with a charge attack against enemy spellcasters. The titan uses tanglefoot bags to immobilize agile opponents.  

 **Morale** If facing a group of enemies, a Vanguard Enforcer quaffs a potion of haste. If reduced to 10 hit points or less a Vanguard titan falls back to regroup and plan a renewed attack. If unable to successfully withdraw from combat a Vanguard Enforcer fights to the death.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 20, **Dex** 15, **Con** 16, **Int** 10, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +13; **CMD** 28  
**Feats** Distracting Charge, Extra Grit, Improved Unarmed Strike, Iron Will, Point Blank Master (military pistol), [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), Psychic Sensitivity, [Weapon Focus (greatsword)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Point-Blank Shot and Precise Shot are one feat, Point-Blank Shot; in their place: Weapon Focus (greatsword).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +10, Climb +7, Fly +10, Intimidate +10, Perception +12, Sense Motive +12, Survival +8  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** deeds (force shot, havoc barrier, pistol whip, unstoppable), dowsing (Survival), grit (1 point), martial training, prognostication (Sense Motive), read aura (Perception)  
**Combat Gear** potion of cure moderate wounds, potion of haste, tanglefoot bag (2); **Other Gear** +1 adamantine greatsword, +3 shocktrooper armor, +1 military pistol (40 rounds), ring of protection +1.  

**Boons**
